steps.name: Resolve Admin verifier base and head
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
case "${EVENT_NAME}" in
  pull_request)
    base="${PR_BASE_SHA}"
    head="${PR_HEAD_SHA}"
    ;;
  push)
    base="${PUSH_BEFORE_SHA}"
    head="${EVENT_SHA}"
    ;;
  workflow_dispatch)
    head="${EVENT_SHA}"
    base="$(git rev-parse "${head}^")"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "unsupported Admin verifier event: ${EVENT_NAME}" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
if [[ ! "${base}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || [[ "${base}" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]]; then
  echo "invalid Admin verifier base SHA: ${base}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! "${head}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "invalid Admin verifier head SHA: ${head}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
test "${base}" != "${head}"
git cat-file -e "${base}^{commit}"
git cat-file -e "${head}^{commit}"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${head}"
echo "admin_verify_base_sha=${base}"
echo "admin_verify_head_sha=${head}"
{
  echo "ADMIN_VERIFY_BASE_SHA=${base}"
  echo "ADMIN_VERIFY_HEAD_SHA=${head}"
} >>"${GITHUB_ENV}"

steps.name: Resolve exact successful Production deployment
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
url=""
for attempt in $(seq 1 72); do
  ids="$(gh api --method GET "/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/deployments?sha=$GITHUB_SHA&per_page=100" --jq '.[] | .id' || true)"
  for id in $ids; do
    deployment="$(gh api --method GET "/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/deployments/$id")"
    production="$(printf '%s' "$deployment" | jq -r '.production_environment // false')"
    environment="$(printf '%s' "$deployment" | jq -r '.environment // ""' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    if [ "$production" != "true" ] && [ "$environment" != "production" ]; then
      continue
    fi
    candidate="$(gh api --method GET "/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/deployments/$id/statuses?per_page=100" \
      --jq '[.[] | select(.state == "success" and .environment_url != null)][0].environment_url // empty' || true)"
    if [ -n "$candidate" ]; then
      url="${candidate%/}"
      break
    fi
  done
  if [ -n "$url" ]; then break; fi
  sleep 5
done
test -n "$url"
printf 'url=%s\n' "$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
